name: 17108-batchdecode-kimilinear48b-tp4
model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, unquantized. PINNED, not substitutable. Public and ungated, but NOT in the local HF cache: ~96 GB downloads once.
parallelism: TP=4, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix structure: 4000 prompt tokens in, 1000 generated out, both FIXED (stdev 0), with `ignore_eos` true and `temperature` 0.0 so every request emits exactly 1000 tokens. Do not relax the lengths to a distribution. Radix cache is off, so every request prefills cold. Seed 17108.
purpose: A long-document report writer on a 48-billion-parameter model, serving 128 concurrent users four-GPU node.
launch:
model-path: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
trust-remote-code: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.83
max-running-requests: 128
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
cuda-graph-bs: [128]
random-seed: 17108
